item.title: Northgate Energy switches on 400 MW sodium-ion battery plant
item.description: The Nevada site is the largest grid storage project built on sodium-ion cells so far, and can discharge for four hours.

item.title: Geothermal startup drills deepest enhanced well yet
item.description: Crews reached 5,200 metres and measured rock at 260 °C, enough to make power without a natural reservoir.
